examples.text: assosi kho keṇiyo jaṭilo, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito aṅg'uttar'āpesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aḍḍhateḷasehi bhikkhusatehi āpaṇaṃ anuppatto.

examples.text: atirekaṃ kho pan'imassa bhoto satthuno naggiyaṃ muṇḍiyaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ kesamassulocanaṃ yo'haṃ puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasanto kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhonto mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārento jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanto iminā bhotā satthārā samasamagatiko bhavissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ.

22871.meaning1: devoted to the practice of plucking out one's hair and beard

examples.text: kesamassulocako'pi hoti kesamassulocan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako'pi hoti āsanappaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko'pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto, kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'pi hoti kaṇṭak'āpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

22872.meaning1: name of a town of the Kālāmas in Kosala
22872.commentary: (ANa) kālāmānaṃ nigamo'ti kālāmā nāma khattiyā, tesaṃ nigamo.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena kesamuttaṃ nāma kālāmānaṃ nigamo tadavasari.

22873.meaning2: from Kesamutta town; living in the town of Kesamutta

examples.text: assosuṃ kho kesamuttiyā kālāmā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kesamuttaṃ anuppatto.
yuttaṃ kiñjakkhareṇunā'ti padumakesarareṇunā yuttaṃ.
tappitā param'annena, sabbe te ariyamaṇḍalā, ratanagabbhaṃ pavisitvā, kesarī'va guh'āsayāā.

22880.meaning1: head hair, body hair, nails, teeth; first four objects of the meditation on unattractiveness
22880.construction:
kesa + loma + nakha + danta + ā
kesalomanakhadanta + ā
22880.compound: dvanda (kesā ca lomā ca nakhā ca dantā ca)

examples.text: disato dvīsu disāsu jātaṃ. okāsato abaddhapittaṃ kesa-loma-nakha-dantānaṃ maṃsavinimuttaṭṭhānaṃ thaddhasukkhacammañ'ca vajjetvā udakam'iva telabindu avasesasarīraṃ byāpetvā ṭhitaṃ, yamhi kupite akkhīni pītakāni honti bhamanti, gattaṃ kampati kaṇḍūyati.

22882.meaning1: edge of the hair; coil of hair

22885.grammar: pron, interr, masc & nt dat pl of ka

examples.text: kesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā, ke janā saggagāmino'ti.
idha mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, kesaṃ nu kho piyo attā, kesaṃ appiyo attā'ti?

22886.grammar: pron, interr, masc & nt gen pl of ka

examples.text: kesū'dha araṇā loke, kesaṃ vusitaṃ na nassati, ke'dha icchaṃ parijānanti, kesaṃ bhojissiyaṃ sadā.
ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kesiṃ assadammasārathiṃ bhagavā etadavoca, tvaṃ kho'si, kesi, paññāto assadammasārathī'ti. kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, kesi, assadammaṃ vinesī'ti?

22892.meaning1: with hair; having a certain kind of hair
22892.commentary: (THIa) lūnakesī'ti lūnā luñcitā kesā mayhan'ti lūnakesī, nigaṇṭhesu pabbajjāya tāl'aṭṭhinā luñcitakesā, taṃ sandhāya vadati. (THIa) vidhutakesatāya pakiṇṇakesī

examples.text: lūnakesī paṅkadharī, ekasāṭī pure cariṃ, avajje vajjamatinī, vajje c'āvajjadassinī.
puttasoken'ahaṃ aṭṭā, khittacittā visaññinī, naggā pakiṇṇakesī ca, tena tena vicāri'haṃ.

22893.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tiss'ūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasikhi taṇhacchido ca sikhari.

22894.grammar: pron, interr, masc & nt loc pl of ka

examples.text: kesu na mānaṃ kayirātha, kesu c'assa sagāravo, ky'assa apacitā assu, ky'assu sādhu supūjitā'ti.

22895.meaning1: among who here; in whom here

examples.text: kesū'dha araṇā loke, kesaṃ vusitaṃ na nassati, ke'dha icchaṃ parijānanti, kesaṃ bhojissiyaṃ sadā.

22896.meaning1: cutting hair; shaving off the hair

examples.text: bhaṇḍukammāyā'ti kes'oropan'atthaṃ.

22897.meaning2: remover of hair; i.e. a barber

22898.commentary: (ANa) kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope'ti kevaṭṭā viya macchavilope. tesañ'hi macchapacchiṃ gahetvā āgatānaṃ vikkiṇanaṭṭhāne, mayhaṃ detha mayhaṃ dethā'ti vadato mahājanassa evarūpo saddo hoti.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti. atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi, ke pana kho, nāgita, uccāsaddamahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope'ti?
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho kevaṭṭo gahapatiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā bhagavati abhippasannā.
